visual_brief.subject: An AI code reviewer can change the evidence and still leave Git clean
verified_context: A Qwen Code contributor reports temporary tracked-source edits in three of four controlled review runs, each ending with a clean Git status.
Other agents shared the checkout, so a final clean tree does not establish what source bytes they read during an edit.
The report does not establish that another agent actually read the temporary edits or that a production merge was wrongly approved.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A clean final surface cannot reveal the temporary evidence another observer might have examined.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A pale layered source artifact appears pristine except for one temporarily displaced layer exposing a terracotta interior beneath a brass inspection lens; the image freezes the inspection moment rather than depicting a proven compromised review.

candidate_notes.A: A lifted insert exposes the terracotta recess clearly, but the broad slab and handheld lens feel more like a product still life than the architectural golden references.
candidate_notes.B: The fanned leaves give a strong silhouette and the temporary exposed layer is clear. The upright composition loses more surrounding structure in the desktop 21:9 crop.
candidate_notes.C: Selected: the open stone folio and fixed brass inspection lens create a coherent tactile artifact. The lifted layer and terracotta interior remain visible in wide, mobile, square and small crops; supporting linework does not carry the composition.

crop_review.article_desktop: Inspected 21:9 center cover crop: lifted layer, terracotta interior and lens remain visible; slab outer ends may crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: Inspected 16:9 crop: entire central folio/lens relationship remains clear.
crop_review.square: Centered square cuts the outer folio edges and lens stand, while retaining the lifted interior and inspection lens.
crop_review.thumbnail: Inspected approximately 320px wide: the pale folio, raised terracotta layer and brass lens retain a distinct silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all three viable candidates against the two declared references for warm paper ground, matte stone materiality, restrained brass/terracotta, spatial depth, visual density and small-size silhouette. C best matches their commissioned artifact language without copying the references.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of all three full-size candidates, two golden references, comparison sheet and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. All three passed the constitutional gate before scoring. The canonical contact-sheet CLI could not launch missing Chromium; Pillow produced the same reference-above-candidates comparison. No repository renderer or gate was changed.

A.prompt:
Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse. Placement: article hero, also category cards. Subject: An AI code reviewer can change the evidence and still leave Git clean. Verified context: A Qwen Code contributor reports temporary tracked-source edits in three of four controlled review runs, each ending with a clean Git status. Other agents shared the checkout, so a final clean tree does not establish what source bytes they read during an edit. The report does not establish that another agent actually read temporary edits or a production merge was wrongly approved. Visual idea: a pale layered source artifact looks pristine except for one temporarily displaced layer exposing a terracotta interior beneath a brass inspection lens; freeze the inspection moment as a metaphor, never represent a proven compromised review. Output crop: wide 16:9; central motif safe in 21:9 desktop, 16:9 mobile, centered square crop and at 320px thumbnail. Keep entire meaningful relationship inside central 55% width and central 65% height, with airy warm paper around it.
Art direction: restrained contemporary editorial illustration with quiet scientific/architectural sensibility. Deliberate geometry, fine supporting lines, subtle paper grain and matte materiality. Harmonize warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35 and restrained aged brass. Controlled perspective, overlapping substantial forms, light tactile depth, strong silhouette, confident asymmetry, spacious composition. The two viewed golden references depict matte pale stone artifacts with terracotta insets and restrained brass inspection mechanisms on warm textured paper; match their editorial materiality and density without copying their compositions. Do not produce a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition or minimalist architecture diagram. Fine technical lines may support the composition but cannot carry it. No words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header, footer, buttons, badges, charts with invented data, watermark, neon effects, robots or generic glowing AI brains. Do not generate a headline or imitate a screenshot. No border or frame. The website renders all text separately.
Composition for this candidate: Canonical composition: a low broad limestone source slab with one rectangular insert hovering a little above its fitted recess, exposing a narrow terracotta interior. One aged brass magnifying lens leans across the recess. Illustrated three-quarter perspective; architectural tactile solidity, meaningful objects centrally grouped.
